title: Rav Rechumi (II)

paragraphs: He was the student of Ravina (Rav Ashi’s colleague), as in Zevachim 77a, where he sat before Ravina and was saying in the name of Rav Huna bar Tachlifa — Ravina said to him, “Torah, Torah.” In Chullin 89a he raised an objection to Ravina; in Yoma 78a he said, “I saw Ravina cross [the water] while wearing [his footwear].”
Hyman identifies this Rav Rechumi as the one who headed the academy after Rafram in Pumbedita, from the year 754 until 757 or 760, as stated explicitly in the Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon.

notes.text: דרך מלבוש concerns crossing while wearing footwear in the saved Davidson Yoma 78a discussion, not passing “by way of a garment.” The academy dates 754, 757 and 760 retain the supplied numerals without an era conversion.

Hyman’s academy-head identification and the dates he reports from the Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon are retained. The exact chronological witness has not been independently inspected here, and no era conversion is supplied.
